subject: "Unable to retrieve package records" for a shinyapps.io with github package

messages.author: 3ef7a01c7d912ca2
messages.subject: "Unable to retrieve package records" for a shinyapps.io with github package
parts:
I have a package on github:

https://github.com/dmenne/gastempt

with a Shiny application. The package compiles ok on TravisCI.

Trying to upload the shiny app within the package to shinyapps.io, I get the following error:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 97004...Fehler: Unable to retrieve package records for the following packages:
- "gastempt"


Any ideas?

Dieter

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: "Unable to retrieve package records" for a shinyapps.io with github package
parts:
The problem is that we're not able to automatically infer where this package's home is if you install it locally. If you install from github using:

devtools::install_github("dmenne/gastempt")

then try publishing to ShinyApps.io again, it should work.
